evidence.excerpt: Official-linked Chowly store 22589 exposes the complete current Herndon catalog: 58 raw product cards across seven categories. Two same-price Antonio pasta cards were consolidated as one product, yielding 57 canonical food and nonalcoholic products.

Current restaurant-issued HTML menu exposes 35 food and nonalcoholic products across pizza, pasta, sandwiches, small plates, sweets, salad, and beverage sections, with ingredient descriptions but no allergen matrix.
Official Crust Herndon homepage identifies Crust Pizzeria Napoletana at 360 Elden Street, Herndon, VA 20170, phone 703-817-2694, with current Sunday-Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday-Saturday hours.
Recent exact-address Grubhub storefront lists 360 Elden St and phone (703) 817-2694 and corroborates the seven-category Chowly catalog and its current descriptions.
